items.docs: Search NAC client authentication event records across the organization with filters for authentication, NAC rule, identity provider, RADIUS, network, endpoint, site, and time attributes.

params.name: ap
params.description: MAC address of the AP the client is/was connected to

params.name: auth_type
params.description: Authentication type, e.g. "eap-tls", "eap-peap", "eap-ttls", "eap-teap", "mab", "psk", "device-auth". Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: cert_expiry_duration
params.description: Filter by certificate expiry within a specific duration from now (e.g., "7d" for 7 days, "1m" for 1 month). Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: edr_managed
params.description: Filters NAC clients that are integrated with EDR providers

params.name: edr_provider
params.description: EDR provider used to filter NAC clients. enum: `crowdstrike`, `sentinelone`

params.name: edr_status
params.description: EDR status used to filter NAC clients. enum: `sentinelone_healthy`, `sentinelone_infected`, `crowdstrike_low`, `crowdstrike_medium`, `crowdstrike_high`, `crowdstrike_critical`, `crowdstrike_informational`

params.name: family
params.description: Partial / full Client family (e.g. "Phone/Tablet/Wearable", "Access Point"). Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `Surveillance*` and `*urveillance*` match `Surveillance Camera`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*Camera`) are not supported. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: hostname
params.description: Partial / full Client hostname. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `everest*` and `*rest*` match `my-everest-client`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*everest`) are not supported. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: idp_id
params.description: SSO ID, if present and used

params.name: mac
params.description: Partial / full Client MAC address. Use a single value; comma-separated values are not supported. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `aabbcc*` and `*bbcc*` match `aabbccddeeff`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*bccddeeff`) are not supported

params.name: mdm_compliance
params.description: MDM compliance of client i.e "compliant", "not compliant"

params.name: mdm_provider
params.description: MDM provider of client’s organization eg "intune", "jamf"

params.name: mdm_managed
params.description: Filters NAC clients that are managed by MDM providers

params.name: mfg
params.description: Partial / full Client manufacturer (e.g. "apple", "cisco", "juniper"). Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `Raspberry Pi*` and `*Pi*` match `Raspberry Pi Trading Ltd`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*Ltd`) are not supported. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: model
params.description: Client model, e.g. "iPhone 12", "MX100"

params.name: nacrule_name
params.description: NAC Policy Rule Name matched

params.name: nacrule_id
params.description: NAC Policy Rule ID, if matched

params.name: nacrule_matched
params.description: NAC Policy Rule Matched

params.name: nas_vendor
params.description: Vendor of NAS device

params.name: nas_ip
params.description: IP address of NAS device. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: ingress_vlan
params.description: Vendor specific VLAN ID in RADIUS requests

params.name: os
params.description: Client OS, e.g. "iOS 18.1", "Android", "Windows", "Linux"

params.name: ssid
params.description: Filter results by SSID

params.name: status
params.description: Client connection status used to filter results. enum: `permitted`, `session_started`, `session_stopped`, `denied`

params.name: text
params.description: partial / full MAC address, last_username, device_mac, nas_ip or last_ap

params.name: type
params.description: Client type i.e. "wireless", "wired" etc. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: usermac_label
params.description: Labels derived from usermac entry

params.name: username
params.description: Filter results by username

params.name: vlan
params.description: Filter results by VLAN ID

params.name: site_id
params.description: Filter results by one site identifier. Use a single value; comma-separated values are not supported

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order.

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search NAC client records across the organization with filters for authentication, endpoint posture, identity, network, NAC rule, site, and time attributes.
Sends CoA (Change of Authorization) command to a NAC client.
